rule.PROMOTE: the arm with the most levels, if it clears 48 or more on its own ordinary commit with the vLLM server healthy for the whole run. It replaces GG7 in tonight's slot (UTC 2026-09-28) through submit_candidate.py with --consume-daily-slot.
